Hi Soojin / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We reviewed the private offer and have two operational blockers before finance can route acceptance: 

- The acceptance window in the offer (30 days) overlaps our internal quarter close; we need a short remediation path so usage won't be billed retroactively to the new tranche until cutover.
- Our AP team requires a clear invoice tranche cutover schedule and VAT evidence (we operate in GB + IE). They also asked for a credits carveout for an overage credit that was promised in Q2 (reference: ticket AQU-435).

Can Redwood propose a remediation timeline and confirm whether the private-offer DocuSign can be split into two invoices (tranche 1: 60% initial, tranche 2: 40% on acceptance window close) or if we need a single invoice with a credit note to follow?

We're aiming to sign by 8/30 but need the billing plan by 8/25 to get AP sign-off. Attaching our AP contact and a short procurement checklist.

Attachments: AQU-AP-Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Best,

Marina — thanks for the clear rundown. We can accommodate a remediation plan that prevents retroactive billing during the acceptance window and offer two operational paths:

1) Tranche invoicing (preferred): issue two invoices tied to milestone dates. Redwood AR will generate invoice #1 for 60% on signature and invoice #2 for 40% at the tranche cutover date you confirm.
2) Single invoice + credit: issue one invoice and follow with a credit note for the overage carveout; this is slower for AP reconciliation but works if splitting is impossible.

Quick asks from our side:
- Confirm the tranche cutover target date (approx. 30 days from signature?)
- Confirm the VAT registration entity for invoice (GB vs IE) and whether Aquila needs us to include a reverse-charge note.

Ben — can you confirm the billing system implication (SAP vs marketplace flow) and whether DocuSign can attach two invoice PDFs so AP has line-of-sight?

Kimberly — looping you for VAT routing and to prepare the tax evidence bundle (SOC2-style invoice metadata + VAT registration extracts). I can draft the remediation plan (attached).

Attachment: Acceptance_Remediation_Plan.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — Soojin

Marina / Soojin — quick operational note from sales/ops:

- Marketplace vs private-offer: because Aquila is accepting via the Azure private offer path, the marketplace billing pipeline can emit two invoices if we provision two invoice items on acceptance. Our Finance team needs the exact cutover timestamp and confirmation that your AP will accept two separate invoice documents.
- DocuSign: we can include both invoice PDFs as attachments in the signing packet; post-sign we push the invoice artifacts to our billing system and Azure Marketplace.

Proposed schedule:
- 8/25: Redwood to deliver tax evidence bundle + final invoice PDFs for tranche 1 and provisional tranche 2 (PDFs will have provisional dates).
- 8/26: Aquila AP confirms invoice split acceptance.
- 8/30: Signature and emission of tranche 1 invoice (60%).
- 9/29: Tranche 2 becomes billable; invoice emitted for 40% (or credit note issued earlier if cutover delayed).

Marina — if the 9/29 date conflicts with your close, propose an alternate tranche 2 date (within 60 days of signature) and we will adjust.

Ben Carter
